addition.item: Initial stable release for Joomla! 5 and Joomla! 6 with full en-GB and pt-BR language packs.

Native DI/MVC component (com_pmdownloads) with multiple versioned releases per item, automatic file size and SHA-256 checksums, protected local streaming (.htaccess and Path::check), safe GitHub Releases redirects, one-click GitHub API sync in Admin, AJAX faceted filters, ID-less SEF routing, multilingual associations, and Schema.org SoftwareApplication JSON-LD.
GitHub-first Update Server XML and Changelog XML integration with dedicated item fields and automatic raw.githubusercontent.com resolution.
Showcase module (mod_pmdownloads) with default, grid, and compact layouts.
Smart Search plugin (plg_finder_pmdownloads) indexing 6 taxonomies and Content shortcode plugin (plg_content_pmdownloads).
Configured native GitHub-hosted Joomla Update Server (updates.xml) and Changelog XML (changelog.xml).
